newsitem.title: USA: First Commercial to acquire WBT Holding.
newsitem.headline: First Commercial to acquire WBT Holding.

text.p: First Commercial Corp said on Friday it has agreed to buy W.B.T. Holding Co and
its United American Bank unit for 1.3 million First Commercial shares.
First Commercial shares were trading down 1/4 at 34-1/2 at midday.

United American serves the Memphis, Tennessee market through six branch and six ATM locations, First Commercial said. United American has assets of $267 million, loans of $177 million and deposits of $244 million.
The deal, which is subject to regulatory approval, is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997, said First Commercial, which has $5.4 billion in assets.
